metadata.title: Convex hulls and area minimizing currents in asymptotically locally hyperbolic manifolds
metadata.abstract: We solve the oriented asymptotic Plateau problem for integral currents of arbitrary codimension in conformally compact asymptotically locally hyperbolic manifolds without global curvature assumptions. This extends Anderson's theorem in hyperbolic space. A new ingredient is the construction of a barrier hull near conformal infinity, which serves as a barrier for area minimizing currents and stationary varifolds. In the conformally compact setting, the associated convex hull identity extends Anderson's result beyond globally pinched negative curvature.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在无全局曲率假设的共形紧化渐近局部双曲流形上，解决任意余维积分流的定向渐近 Plateau 问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 新构造的无穷远 barrier hull 把 Anderson 的双曲空间定理推广到更一般背景，并延伸凸包恒等式。
analysis.limitations: 需要共形紧化和渐近局部双曲结构；解的唯一性与边界正则性未在摘要中给出。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 24/30、新颖性与强度 18/25、技术复用性 14/20、潜在影响 10/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 74/100。
